Trying costs 50 stamped dockets, each costing £18 to have checked a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The nectar is on the docket. dune is written on the receipt. mesa stays on the record.
